reduction.native_correctness_debt: cache-disabled serialized and parallel builds independently reproduce late build-archive EFAULT failures

gates.within_1x_uncached_wall: fail: best correct cache point is 1.029532x uncached
gates.warm_cache_step_function: fail: second build is 1.020203x first build
gates.correctness_and_cleanup: pass for best bounded cache point; separate cache-disabled EFAULT debt remains

reason: Address-mode keying fixes the deterministic replay corruption and the best bounded cache point completes correctly with output 42, but it takes 60.472 seconds versus the 58.737-second uncached control (1.029532x slower). Scaling from 71,244 to 931,094 hits regresses wall to 73.568 seconds, and a fully pre-warmed second build with an independent empty Go cache is 1.020203x slower than its first build. Per-block JSON artifact lookup/replay is therefore not the step-function architecture; do not proceed to a production implementation. Preserve the separate cache-disabled build-archive EFAULT as native correctness debt.
